newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi recalls 15,000 of its A3, A4, A6 cars.
newsitem.headline: Audi recalls 15,000 of its A3, A4, A6 cars.

text.p: German carmaker Audi, a unit of Volkswagen AG, said on Saturday it was recalling 15,000 of its A3, A4 and A6 cars for repairs to the front seat safety belts.
The company said in a statement that cars built between February and mid-March of this year needed to be checked and, if necessary, variable-height safety belt fittings replaced.
All car owners were being written to and informed of the recall, Audi said. The company added that cars built for sale to the United States and Japan were not affected.
